info.title: Keyfactor API Reference and Utility
info.description:
This page provides a utility through which the Keyfactor API endpoints can be called and results returned. It is intended to be used primarily for validation, testing and workflow development. It also serves secondarily as documentation for the API.

If you would like to view documentation containing details on the Keyfactor API and endpoints, please refer to the Web API section of the Keyfactor Command documentation.

get.summary: Returns local PAM entries for the given PAM provider according to the provided filter and output parameters

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: Keyfactor identifier of the PAM provider

parameters.name: QueryString
parameters.description: Contents of the query (ex: field1 -eq value1 AND field2 -gt value2)

parameters.name: PageReturned
parameters.description: The current page within the result set to be returned

parameters.name: ReturnLimit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to be returned in a single call

parameters.name: SortField
parameters.description: Field by which the results should be sorted (view results via Management Portal for sortable columns)

parameters.name: SortAscending
parameters.description: Field sort direction [0=ascending, 1=descending]

parameters.name: x-keyfactor-api-version
parameters.description: Desired version of the api, if not provided defaults to v1

parameters.name: x-keyfactor-requested-with
parameters.description: Type of the request [XMLHttpRequest, APIClient]
